texts.label: text
texts.orig: Please consider, 15°C with 40% air humidity would create a much dryer environment than at 25°C with the  same  air  humidity  level.  Same  would  25°C  with  60%  air  humidity  give  a  much  more  humid environment than 60% air humidity at 15°C, as the air on higher temperatures can carry much more water.
